info.name: Pepperdata REST Alarms Job Details API

params.name: s
params.description: Start time of query. Absolute (2020/07/20-05:54), relative (1h), or timestamp (1595163240000).

params.name: e
params.description: End time of the query. Defaults to current time.

params.name: tzo
params.description: Time zone offset in hours (e.g. PDT: -7).

params.name: j
params.description: Filter by job IDs (comma-separated).

params.name: apptype
params.description: Type of app.

params.name: finalstatus
params.description: Final status of the app.

params.name: resolvedstatus
params.description: Resolved status: first available of FINAL_STATUS or APP_STATE, otherwise INVALID.

params.name: appstate
params.description: Current status of the app.

params.name: sdelay
params.description: Minimum time (ms) in queue from submission to first container launch.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of apps to return (max 10,000).

params.name: showalldetails
params.description: Set to 1 to return app profiler details (configuration properties, recommendations, counters).

params.name: recommendationsonly
params.description: Return only apps with recommendations (equivalent to recommendationsgte=low).

params.name: recommendationsgte
params.description: Filter by minimum recommendation severity.

params.name: recommendationsmatching
params.description: Filter by specified severity levels (comma-separated: critical, severe, moderate, low, none).

params.name: fetchsparkdetails
params.description: Set to 1 for Spark driver metadata (executors, stages). Spark only; most recent 100 jobs, 1000 stages, 24 hours.

params.name: fetchtaskdetails
params.description: Set to 1 for container error exit codes (up to 50 containers with errors).

params.name: workflowid
params.description: Filter by specified workflow ID.

params.name: filterjobidsafter
params.description: Return only jobs running after the specified job ID (pagination cursor).

params.name: namespace
params.description: Filter by cluster namespace (Kubernetes only).

params.name: showmaybesettleddata
params.description: Set to 1 to include data asynchronously populated later in the metrics pipeline.

items.docs: Retrieve application/job details for the realm. By default the response contains the most recent apps. All access is via HTTP GET with query arguments. Paginate large result sets with filterjobidsafter.
